title: The Powerhouse Recipes repository is the canonical catalog of runnable Reactor patterns
content:
`github.com/powerhouse-inc/recipes` holds 21 standalone projects, each a clonable-and-runnable demonstration of one Reactor pattern. The Cookbook's recipe table and its per-recipe detail sections are **auto-generated** from that repo by `scripts/generate-recipe-docs.ts` — the academy markdown carries an explicit "do not edit directly" marker — so the repo, not the docs, is the source of truth.

Grouped by what they teach:

| Theme | Recipes |
| --- | --- |
| Read models & projection | analytics-processor, custom-read-model, full-text-search, semantic-search, relational-db-subgraph |
| Cross-document automation | cross-document-reactor, saga, batch-progress |
| External integrations | external-feed-ingest, inbound-webhook-bridge, discord-webhook-processor |
| Identity, auth & limits | role-based-auth, signed-operations-verifier, rate-limiter, audit-trail |
| Sync & ops | sync-health-monitor, subscription-cli, db-migrate, document-snapshot-exporter |
| Schema evolution & containers | document-versioning, drive-override |

Several are the *only* documentation of their subject at any depth — `document-versioning` on the `initialState` replay trap, `inbound-webhook-bridge` on raw-bytes HMAC verification, `drive-override` on `ADD_RELATIONSHIP` scaling. Where the reference docs and a recipe overlap, the recipe usually carries the failure mode and the test that proves it.

Two properties make them unusually citable. Most run **fully offline** on an in-process PGlite-backed reactor with no external services, and most **generate their document models from a committed spec** via `ph generate document-model --document <spec>.json` with a pinned `ph-cli`, so the codegen output in the repo matches a known toolchain version. Several also pair a demo (`pnpm start`) with a test suite that asserts the pathological case rather than just the happy path.

Recipes are AGPL-3.0-only where licensing is stated.

Provenance: academy `05-Lookup/00-Cookbook.md`, "Reactor Recipes" section (auto-generated block), academy 6.2.2-dev.45.
description: 21 self-contained projects at github.com/powerhouse-inc/recipes, auto-generated into the Cookbook, covering processors, read models, sync, auth, integrations and versioning.
